blocks.text: Khalis pani bijli ka kamzor conductor hai, magar us ki conductance napi ja sakti hai kyunke pani reversible taur par khud-ionise (self-ionise) hota hai: H2O(l) + H2O(l) se H3O+(aq) + OH-(aq), ya kul reaction ke taur par H2O(l) se H+(aq) + OH-(aq). Equilibrium constant Kc = [H+][OH-] / [H2O] = 1.8 x 10^-16 mol dm-3 hai. Khalis pani mein pani ki concentration 1000 g dm-3 ko 18 g mol-1 par taqseem kar ke 55.5 mol dm-3 hai; chunke pani bohat zyada miqdar mein hai aur us ke bohat kam molecules ionise hote hain, us ki concentration asal mein mustaqil rehti hai. Yeh mustaqil concentration baen taraf le ja kar Kc se zarb di jati hai aur ek aur constant Kw milta hai: Kc [H2O] = [H+][OH-], ya 1.8 x 10^-16 x 55.5 = 1.01 x 10^-14 = [H+][OH-]. Yeh 1.01 x 10^-14 25 degrees C par pani ka Kw hai, pani ka ionic product ya dissociation constant: Kw = [H+][OH-] = 10^-14 25 degrees C par. Darja hararat 0 se 100 degrees C karne par Kw ki qeemat taqreeban 75 guna barh jati hai.

Neutral pani ke liye [H+] = [OH-], to [H+]^2 = 10^-14 25 degrees C par aur [H+] = 10^-7 mol dm-3 aur [OH-] = 10^-7 mol dm-3. Jab bhi pani mein kuch acid ya base dala jaye to Kw wahi rehta hai magar [H+] aur [OH-] ab barabar nahi rehte: thore acid ke saath [H+] [OH-] se zyada, aur base ke chand qatron ke saath [OH-] [H+] se zyada. Dono soorton mein Kw 25 degrees C par 10^-14 rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: [H2O] ko constant mein kyun shamil kiya ja sakta hai, aur 25 degrees C par pani mein thora acid dalne se [H+] aur [OH-] ko kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Pani 55.5 mol dm-3 par hai aur taqreeban aadhe arab mein se ek molecule ionise hota hai, to us ki concentration asal mein mustaqil rehti hai aur Kc zarb 55.5 naya constant Kw = 1.01 x 10^-14 deta hai. Acid dalne se [H+] barhta hai; hasil-e-zarb [H+][OH-] ab bhi 10^-14 hona chahiye, to [OH-] 10^-7 se neeche girta hai jabke [H+] us se oopar jata hai.

items: H2O se H+ + OH-; Kc = 1.8 x 10^-16, [H2O] = 55.5 mol dm-3, to Kw = [H+][OH-] = 1.01 x 10^-14 25 degrees C par (pani ka ionic product); 0 se 100 degrees C tak Kw taqreeban 75 guna barhta hai.
Neutral pani: [H+] = [OH-] = 10^-7 mol dm-3; acid ya base dalne se dono concentrations badalti hain magar Kw nahi.
